de: Pepin of Herstal, mayor of the Merovingian palace, dies at Jupille (modern Belgium). He is succeeded by his infant grandson Theudoald, while his widow Plectrude holds actual power in the Frankish Kingdom.

dz: 《文摘》是所有罗马法学家法律的伟大汇编,它与一份供法学院使用的新的正式法律教科书《研究所》一起出版.
de: The Digest, the great collection of all Roman jurists' law, is issued together with a new official law textbook for legal schools, The Institutes.
